description: Estimate duties, tariffs, taxes and fees for goods moving into Canada or the US, by parcel or freight (truck, rail, air, ocean), and whether any item is banned. Gives who pays under the Incoterm, and what the exporting country requires. Use before buying from or shipping across the border.

date.description: Date the parcel enters the destination country

freight.description: International transport cost in the destination currency, to split costs by the Incoterm

incoterm.description: Incoterms 2020 term of sale; FAS, FOB, CFR and CIF are for sea and inland waterway

insurance.description: Cargo insurance cost in the destination currency

cusmaClaim.description: True if the seller will claim CUSMA preference for this item

hs.description: Tariff classification (HS code), at least 4 digits, for example 6109.10

origin.description: Country where the product was made, for example HN for Honduras

mode.description: mail or courier for parcels (low value allowances apply); road (truck), rail, air, sea or inland_waterway for commercial freight

paidBy.description: Who pays border charges: the customer at the door (DAP), or the seller in advance (DDP). Ignored when incoterm is given

personal.description: true when a person buys the goods for their own use, as a shopper's parcel is; some surtaxes spare those. Leave out for a business import

region.description: Destination province or state, for example AB or ON

name: border_quote
title: Border cost check
